sent_to_model:
I've reached review number 1000 and I want to celebrate with a review of Mr. Bean! This show means so much to me, i can watch it again and again and still enjoy it. Can you help me put together a review for other people on the review site, about 260 words? I want to share why i love Rowan Atkinson and the rest of the cast, and why the episodes work so well. My favorite is the Amazing Adventures of Mr. Bean. I wish there had been more of the show! I'm giving it five stars and want anyone who hasn't watched it to give it a go.

- This will be my 1000th review.
- Matilda Ziegler plays Irma.
- Rowan Atkinson stars as Mr. Bean.
- Robyn Driscoll also involved; deserves recognition.
- The show has a large following.
- Five stars; maximum rating.
- Wish the series had continued longer.
- Amazing Adventures of Mr. Bean is my personal favorite.
- Atkinson has extraordinary comic talent; might be the greatest comedian.
- Bean finds inventive solutions when faced with difficult problems.
- Supporting performers do a great job, especially Driscoll and Ziegler.
- Love the writing and direction throughout the series.
- Every episode feels like a classic; enjoy all of them.
- Among my absolute favorite television shows; possibly the funniest.
- Repeated viewing never gets boring.
- Think Driscoll is exceptionally talented too.
- Encourage anyone unfamiliar with the show to watch it soon.
- Make clear how strongly I love the character and series.

(About me: enthusiastic television reviewer. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: The writer chose Mr. Bean to celebrate their 1000th review.
Rowan Atkinson and the supporting cast deserve praise.
The writer explains why the episodes work so well.

The writer awards five stars and urges unfamiliar viewers to watch.
